text: Ko ɓen woni annditirooɓe Alla e kala fiyaake ; nde ɓe darii maa ɓe jooɗii maa nde ɓe lelori becce maɓɓe ɗen, hiɓe miijitora fii tagu kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin ɓe wi'a: "Joomi amen, A Tagiraali nguu tagu mawngu meere, senayee woodanii Ma e ɗum, Ɗaɗndu men e lepte yiite, Waɗtidaa men e moƴƴuɓe ɓen, Reena men e boneeji".
